parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply $\dfrac A{2x+1}+\dfrac B{2x+3}+\dfrac C{(2x+3)^2}$ [B1]. Use a correct method to find a constant [M1]. Obtain $A=1$, $B=-1$, $C=3$ [A1+A1+A1; all three correct constants earn full marks even if the fractions are not explicitly written]. Printed alternative: $\dfrac A{2x+1}+\dfrac{Dx+E}{(2x+3)^2}$ with $A=1,D=-2,E=0$. Total 5.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Integrate and obtain $\frac12\ln(2x+1)-\frac12\ln(2x+3)-\frac3{2(2x+3)}$ [B1+B1+B1; FT on $A,B,C$]. For the $A,D,E$ form, correct integration by parts of the second partial fraction gives $\frac12\ln(2x+1)+\frac{x}{2x+3}-\frac12\ln(2x+3)$. Substitute limits correctly in an integral with terms $a\ln(2x+1)$, $b\ln(2x+3)$, and $c/(2x+3)$, where $abc\ne0$ [M1]; if using the alternative form, use $cx/(2x+3)$. Guidance: upper-limit value minus lower-limit value; one substitution slip can still score M1; condone omission of $\ln1$. Obtain the given answer following full and correct working [A1]. Guidance: at least one interim step of valid logarithm work must be seen; AG. Total 5.
